title: ServiceStarted
description: notifications/serviceStarted: a run's instance is running. Sent once, before any of its output.

container.description: The runtime's name for the instance's container.

documentPath.description: Where the instance reads its document: the path the image's own arguments name. Present when the run gave a document.

address.description: The host address the instance's ports are published on, as service.host names it for the run's runtime.
